summary.motive: Punish aggressive single-high run defenses by faking the pin-and-pull sweep and launching a vertical seam strike to the primary tight end behind suckered linebackers and safeties.
summary.whyItWorks: The single-high safety and linebackers bite hard downhill on the simulated pin-pull pull action, completely vacating the deep middle and seam areas where the tight end releases vertically with maximum speed.
summary.failureMode: A deep Free Safety who maintains discipline without biting downhill, or an immediate free edge rusher disrupting the under-center 7-step drop.

beats.title: Identical Heavy 13-Personnel Picture
beats.text: Offense lines up in the exact same condensed 13-personnel wing formation that established the pin-and-pull perimeter run.

beats.title: The Linebacker Run-Fit Trap
beats.text: Offensive line sells lateral pull steps while QB meshes hard with the RB. Mike LB, Will LB, and Strong Safety SS all sprint downhill into the line.

beats.title: The Seam Release into the Void
beats.text: Y tight end flash-chips the defensive end and explodes untouched up the right seam, running into the massive intermediate void vacated by the linebackers.

beats.title: The Deep Shot Strike
beats.text: QB violently pulls the ball, sets at 7-step depth, and delivers a laser down the seam to Y for a 25-yard touchdown behind the stranded safety.

relations.tell: Y releases vertically after flash down-block; QB sets deep in pocket instead of handing off.
